title: Annual Board Examination Section A Simulator 8 (15 Marks · 20 Min)

questions.question: Which keyword in Python is used inside a function to modify a variable defined at the top module level?
questions.explanation: The `global` keyword allows reassigning variables declared outside the local function scope.

questions.question: What is an 'Anomaly Detection' algorithm primarily used for in banking data science?

options.A: Identifying unusual credit card transactions that deviate from normal user patterns to flag fraud
options.B: Calculating compound interest rates on savings accounts

questions.explanation: Anomaly detection identifies statistical outliers and unusual transaction patterns indicating fraud.

questions.question: What does the term 'Smart City' refer to in IoT applications?

options.A: An urban area that uses IoT sensors and data analytics to optimize city assets, traffic flow, waste management, and energy grids
options.B: A city where all citizens are computer programmers
options.C: A municipality that operates without police departments

questions.explanation: Smart cities leverage connected infrastructure to improve civic efficiency, sustainability, and citizen welfare.

questions.question: What is 'Spear Phishing'?

options.A: A highly targeted phishing attack customized with personalized information to deceive a specific high-profile individual
options.B: Sending generic spam to millions of random email addresses
options.C: Using physical fishing spears to damage undersea internet cables
options.D: Attacking network routers with brute-force scripts

questions.explanation: Spear phishing targets specific executives or employees using researched personal details to bypass skepticism.

questions.question: In agile software estimation, what are 'Story Points' used for?

options.A: Relative units of measure used by teams to estimate the overall effort, complexity, and uncertainty of a user story
options.B: Financial bonuses awarded to engineers who write the most lines of code
options.C: The number of typos detected by the compiler
options.D: The physical weight of the server hardware

questions.explanation: Story points express relative effort without tying estimates to rigid hours, accounting for complexity and risk.

questions.question: What is 'Continuous Monitoring' in cloud DevOps and cyber defense?

options.A: Real-time automated tracking of system performance, server health, application logs, and security telemetry
options.B: Installing CCTV cameras in office cubicles
options.D: Manually testing code once every six months

questions.explanation: Continuous monitoring uses automated observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana) to detect anomalies and crashes instantly.

questions.question: Jakob Nielsen's usability heuristic 'Match between system and real world' recommends:

options.A: Using words, phrases, and concepts familiar to the user rather than system-oriented terms
options.B: Translating all computer text into Latin
options.D: Requiring VR headsets for all web browsing

questions.explanation: Interfaces should speak the users' language with familiar conventions and real-world logic.

questions.question: Which data structure is most efficient for implementing a priority queue where highest priority items are extracted first?
questions.explanation: Binary heaps allow both insertion and highest-priority extraction in logarithmic $O(\log n)$ time.

questions.question: What does the Python expression `lambda a, b: a if a > b else b` accomplish?

options.A: It returns the maximum of two numbers
options.B: It calculates the average of two numbers
options.C: It swaps two numbers in memory
options.D: It returns true if both numbers are prime

questions.explanation: This ternary lambda function compares two arguments and returns the larger value.

questions.question: In data analysis, which method is used to eliminate multi-collinearity between predictor variables?
questions.explanation: PCA projects correlated features onto orthogonal principal components, eliminating multi-collinearity.

questions.question: Which IoT communication protocol operates over IEEE 802.15.4 standard for low-power, low-bandwidth personal area networks?
questions.explanation: Zigbee is a low-power, low-data-rate wireless mesh network standard for home automation and smart energy.

questions.question: What is 'Cross-Site Request Forgery' (CSRF)?

options.A: An attack that tricks a victim into executing unwanted actions on a web application in which they are currently authenticated
options.B: Physical theft of office router cables
options.C: Cracking Wi-Fi WPA2 passwords via dictionary attacks
options.D: Generating fake SSL certificates on an offline laptop

questions.explanation: CSRF exploits trusting web applications by submitting unauthorized forged HTTP requests using the victim's active cookies.

questions.question: What does the 'Lean Startup' methodology prioritize above all else?

options.A: Rapid experimentation, validated learning, and iterative product releases
options.B: Writing 500-page business plans before building anything
options.C: Hiring hundreds of employees before launching
options.D: Investing all capital into television advertisements

questions.explanation: Eric Ries's Lean Startup focuses on the Build-Measure-Learn feedback loop to eliminate wasted effort.

questions.question: In CSS web accessibility, what does the `aria-hidden='true'` attribute tell screen readers?

options.A: To completely ignore the element and its children during auditory reading
options.B: To read the text three times louder
options.C: To translate the text into Braille automatically
options.D: To change the background color to black

questions.explanation: `aria-hidden='true'` hides decorative icons or duplicate content from assistive screen readers.

questions.question: What is the time complexity of finding an element in an unsorted array of size $n$ using linear search?
questions.explanation: Linear search checks each element one by one from beginning to end, requiring $O(n)$ comparisons in the worst case.
